name: The Hollow Vessel
source:
A doll sits alone in a far-off wasteland pit.
For the first time someone finds her in this entropized limbo.

[From [url=https://claymoregwen.itch.io/the-hollow-vessel]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一具人偶独自坐在遥远荒原的一处坑洞里。

在这片熵化的夹缝中，第一次有人发现了她。

[来源：[url=https://claymoregwen.itch.io/the-hollow-vessel]Itch.io[/url]]
